resources.string: Pair with browser
Your saved routes and imported GPX tracks can also be in the web planner on your computer – both ways, encrypted on the device before they leave it.
On the computer, open plan.onpath.earth → ☰ → Pair phone. Scan the code shown there with your phone's camera – OnPath opens and shows six check digits.
Open camera
